title.zh: 水的循环 · 一滴水的旅行
title.en: The Water Cycle · One Drop's Journey

description.zh: 海洋、空气、陆地三个水库之间的蒸发、降水与径流使总量守恒，各处水量收敛到稳定值。速率常数为教学示意值。
description.en: Evaporation, rain and runoff between ocean, air and land reservoirs conserve the total and settle each store at a steady value. Rate constants are illustrative.

label.zh: 流出量随存量增大而自我平衡
label.en: Outflow grows with the stock and balances itself

reason.zh: 空气里的水越多降水越多，陆地水越多径流越多：流出与存量成正比，使各水库自动趋向稳定值，是负反馈的最简单例子。
reason.en: More water in the air means more rain and more on land means more runoff: outflow proportional to stock drives each reservoir toward a steady value, the simplest case of negative feedback.

title.zh: 水循环里的水为什么不会越来越多或越来越少？
title.en: Why does the water in the cycle neither pile up nor run out?

ask.zh: 海洋、空气、陆地三个水库之间，水通过蒸发、降水、径流流动，总量变了吗？
ask.en: Water flows between ocean, air and land through evaporation, rain and runoff — does the total amount change?

ask.zh: 如果某处水变多了，流出会变快还是变慢？这种“多了就流走得更快”会让水量稳定下来吗？
ask.en: If one store holds more water, does its outflow speed up or slow down? Does "more water flows out faster" settle the amount at a steady value?

reveal.zh: 水只是在三个水库之间搬家，总量守恒；某处水多则流出加快、水少则流出减慢，于是各处水量收敛到稳定值。
reveal.en: Water only moves between the three stores, so the total is conserved; a fuller store drains faster and an emptier one drains slower, so each store settles at a steady value.
